# Frozen proof evidence

These files are byte-exact proof exports, authenticated by [EVIDENCE.json](../EVIDENCE.json). They are evidence dependencies, not new results of this package. Their internal relative links refer to their original package at the manifest commit.

- `pr2731-README.md`: starship-s, sharp residual storage and retained-role proof, PR2731; retains its credit to Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml and earlier source authors.
- `pr2708-README.md`: Nick Petalas, route/key storage and caller-phase proof, PR2708; retains its source credit and Apache-2.0 statement.
- `pr2688-PROOF.md` and `pr2688-NOTICE.md`: ywz65, canonical-directory storage proof, PR2688; the original notice preserves source attribution.

The inherited numerical/source implementation itself is separately frozen in `../predecessor/`. The local reserve uses these proofs only within their stated contracts and explicitly accounts for the new recursive frames. No component proof is silently promoted to a complete caller or a physical fixed-tape theorem.
